title: bridge-action.json (contract 1)
description: Written by the page or the service to 0:/sys/workshop/data/bridge-action.json (atomically: temporary file + rename). The bridge looks at the file about once a second, runs an action whose seq it has not seen, and answers in bridge-state.json key 'action' with the same seq. The file is created by the bridge with {"seq": null}.

seq.description: Unique and increasing per sender (the service uses epoch milliseconds). The same seq is never run twice.

action.description: debug, debug_extend, restart, kick, rename, give_control, release, trust, block, unblock, set_password, clear_password, stop_safe, resume_arm, resume_disarm, interrupted_discard (see CONTRACT.md). An unknown action is answered ok:false.
